# betterado_project_permissions (Resource)

Manages project-level ACL permissions in Azure DevOps (Project security namespace).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "betterado_project" "example" {
  name               = "Example Project"
  description        = "Managed by Terraform"
  visibility         = "private"
  version_control    = "Git"
  work_item_template = "Agile"
}

data "betterado_group" "example" {
  project_id = betterado_project.example.id
  name       = "[Example Project]\\Readers"
}

resource "betterado_project_permissions" "example" {
  project_id = betterado_project.example.id
  principal  = data.betterado_group.example.descriptor
  replace    = false

  permissions = {
    GENERIC_READ            = "allow"
    GENERIC_WRITE           = "deny"
    DELETE                  = "deny"
    PUBLISH_TEST_RESULTS    = "deny"
    ADMINISTER_BUILD        = "deny"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `permissions` (Map of String) Map of permission bit names to `allow`, `deny`, or `notset` (lowercase). Values are stored and compared lowercase.
- `principal` (String) The group or user descriptor to assign permissions to.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the Azure DevOps project.

### Optional

- `replace` (Boolean) If true (default), replaces existing ACEs for this principal. If false, merges.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The resource ID, formed as `<token>/<principal>`.
